guide_lib.book.economy.desc: How to earn and spend money
guide_lib.economy.page.overview.p1:
Earn money from everyday Minecraft
activities, then spend it at NPC shops,
invest in ETF shares, and trade
with other players.
guide_lib.economy.page.overview.p2:
[Basic loop]
① Mine, harvest, fish, and fight for rewards
② Deposit spare cash at an ATM
③ Buy and sell at shops, invest in ETF
④ Trade on the flea market
guide_lib.economy.page.money.basics:
Money is split between cash
(on hand) and bank savings.
Shops and the flea market
usually pay from cash.
Your balance appears in UIs and chat.
guide_lib.economy.page.money.rewards:
[How to earn]
· Mine ores
· Harvest crops, pumpkins, melons
· Fish (rarer fish pay more)
· Kill mobs (split by damage dealt)
Chat shows "Earned ¥…" when
you get a reward.
guide_lib.economy.page.money.penalty:
[Watch out]
Dying costs part of your cash.
Money in the bank is safe.
Deposit at an ATM before
carrying large amounts.
guide_lib.economy.page.atm.spotlight:
Right-click an ATM in the world
to open deposit and withdraw screens.
guide_lib.economy.page.atm.usage:
Enter an amount, then:
Deposit — cash to bank
Withdraw — bank to cash
Use ±10,000 / ±1,000 / ±100,
ALL buttons, or hold to adjust quickly.
guide_lib.economy.page.shop_npc.spotligh:
Right-click villager-style NPCs
to open a shop screen.
Each location may buy, sell,
trade stocks, or run a flea market.
guide_lib.economy.page.shop_npc.types:
[NPC roles]
· Shop — buy items
· Pawn shop — sell your items
· Exchange — ETF trading screen
· Flea market — player listings
They look like villagers;
interact to see what each one does.
guide_lib.economy.page.shop_npc.trade:
Pick an item from the list,
then Buy/Sell 1 or 16.
Balance, inventory count, and
purchase limits are shown.
Buttons gray out if you
cannot afford the trade.
guide_lib.economy.page.stock_trade.spotl:
Right-click the Mobile Terminal
or talk to an exchange NPC
to trade ETF shares
from anywhere.
guide_lib.economy.page.stock_trade.tabs:
[Tabs]
· Market info — price charts
· Normal trade — buy / sell shares
· Short selling — short / cover
Pick a stock, set quantity,
then execute.
guide_lib.economy.page.stock_trade.tips:
[Tips]
ETF prices move when players
trade related items at shops.
Buy low, sell high.
Short selling lets you profit
when you expect a price drop.
guide_lib.economy.page.flea_market.overv:
Talk to a flea market NPC
to buy and sell with other players.
List rare items or spare materials
at your own price.
guide_lib.economy.page.flea_market.list:
On New Listing, pick an item,
set unit price and quantity.
Listed items leave your inventory
until sold or cancelled.
Use My Listings to cancel.
guide_lib.economy.page.flea_market.buy:
On Market, browse other players'
listings. Check seller, price,
and remaining quantity.
Buy with cash; items go
to your inventory.
guide_lib.economy.page.loan.spotlight:
Right-click the pillager-style
loan NPC to borrow or repay.
guide_lib.economy.page.loan.borrow:
Enter an amount and borrow.
Cash is added to your hand,
but +10% interest (rounded)
is added to your debt.
The repay preview shows
the total before you confirm.
guide_lib.economy.page.loan.repay:
Repay from cash on hand.
Repay ALL fills the smaller of
debt and cash.
guide_lib.economy.page.admin_setup.p1:
[Starting Economy]
1. Install the mod on your world/server
2. On first world load,
   config/economy/economy_master.json
   is created automatically
3. Get NPC spawn eggs from the
   admin block Spawner tab
4. When players join,
   balance data is created in the world
guide_lib.economy.page.admin_setup.p2:
Works in singleplayer, LAN,
and dedicated servers.
No Node.js server required.

The master JSON is exported
on first world load.
GUI saves also write to
the same file.
guide_lib.economy.page.admin_block.spotl:
The Economy Admin Block is
a 3×2 bulletin board.
Right-click to open the admin GUI.
guide_lib.economy.page.admin_block.place:
[Placement]
Needs a clear 3 wide × 2 tall area.
Place on the bottom-center block;
the other five blocks fill in.

[Permissions]
View balances — everyone
Edit master / reset — solo host or OP
guide_lib.economy.page.admin_gui.tabs:
[Main tabs]
· Balance — view player cash,
  bank, and debt
· Master — balance, rewards,
  prices, shop assignment, ETF
· Spawner — NPC spawn eggs
· Admin — data reset,
  ranking compile
guide_lib.economy.page.admin_gui.master:
[Master tab edits]
· Balance — death penalty,
  short-sell limit, ETF interval,
  loan limits
· Rewards — reward amounts
· Prices — buy/sell for
  existing items
· Shop assignment — NPC shop,
  daily/personal limits
· ETF — influence weights

Save writes to
config/economy/economy_master.json
guide_lib.economy.page.admin_gui.manage:
[Admin tab]
Reset balances, rankings,
ETF, shop limits, flea market,
etc. individually.

Reset to bundled overwrites
 the master JSON with the
mod default (file is kept).
guide_lib.economy.page.admin_json.file:
[Config file]
config/economy/economy_master.json

· Auto-exported on first
  world load
· GUI saves update the
  same file
· Restart the world after
  manual edits to apply
guide_lib.economy.page.admin_json.sectio:
[Edit in JSON]
· items — add items,
  itemKey (other mods OK),
  names, buy/sell prices
· shopItems — new shop
  listings, order
· shops — shop names,
  NPC types
· etfItems — new ETF links
· actionRewards — new
  reward types

The GUI only changes
values on existing rows.
guide_lib.economy.page.admin_json.tips:
[Tips]
· itemKey format:
  modid:item_id
  (e.g. minecraft:iron_ingot)
· shopItems itemId must
  match items.id
· Invalid JSON breaks loading

After a mod update, diff your
config against the bundled
JSON and merge new entries.
